definitions.gloss: to edit; to compile; to put together
definitions.explanation: To select, arrange, revise, or process material (text, video, images, etc.) into a finished form. Covers editing of written works, video, audio, and digital content.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}を{編集|へんしゅう}する。
{彼|かれ}は{雑誌|ざっし}の{記事|きじ}を{編集|へんしゅう}している。
examples.english: He is editing a magazine article.

examples.japanese: {撮影|さつえい}した{写真|しゃしん}をアプリで{編集|へんしゅう}してからSNSに{投稿|とうこう}した。
examples.english: I edited the photos I took with an app before posting them on social media.

notes:
A versatile word covering all types of editing — text, video, audio, images, and code. In modern usage, especially common in the context of digital content creation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動画|どうが}を{編集|へんしゅう}する: to edit a video
- {原稿|げんこう}を{編集|へんしゅう}する: to edit a manuscript
- {編集|へんしゅう}{者|しゃ}: editor
- {編集|へんしゅう}{部|ぶ}: editorial department
- {編集|へんしゅう}{長|ちょう}: editor-in-chief
- {編集|へんしゅう}{作業|さぎょう}: editing work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {校正|こうせい}する: to proofread — checking for errors in a near-final text
- {修正|しゅうせい}する: to revise, correct — making specific fixes
- {加工|かこう}する: to process, retouch — often used for image editing
